target: Official district Kharif rice yield, kg/ha
issue: October 31, composites fully completed by October 24; retrospective reprocessed data
training_reason: Freeze through 2011 so even first 2013 assessment respects assumed Y-2 yield availability.
model: GradientBoostingRegressor predicts deviation from five-lag yield mean; add reference and clip at zero
imputation: Training-only medians and missingness indicators; drop predictors completely missing in training; no target imputation.
selection: No parameter search, feature selection using outcomes, test-based tuning or automatic model replacement.
inference: No Gaussian predictor or residual distribution required for these prediction trees. Metrics are predictive, not coefficient significance tests.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap of assessment-year MAE differences, 10000 draws, seed 42; only five years per period, coarse retrospective uncertainty.
limitations: Years already examined previously; not new independent confirmation.
Fixed district reference and annual paddy masks do not certify annual Kharif boundaries or harvested rice.
October estimate may be near or after harvest in some areas; not a verified pre-harvest or operational forecast.
Weather stops August 24; added LAI also adds later-season information, not an isolated causal vegetation effect.
Missingness indicators can encode cloud/coverage differences; no claim of causal LAI effect.
Neither annual app model metrics nor paper metrics are directly comparable to this seasonal target/sample.
